nodes.label: VPN Config Sales via Telegram Bot
nodes.rationale: Bot sells 3X-UI VPN configs with TON cryptocurrency payment support. Combines Telegram bot interface, crypto payments, and VPN panel management into one product.

nodes.label: TON Non-Bounceable Address Requirement
nodes.rationale: TON wallet address must be non-bounceable (UQ... prefix, 48 chars) for receiving payments. Bounceable addresses (EQ...) are for smart contracts only and may cause payments to bounce.

nodes.label: BigInt Money Rule
nodes.rationale: All wallet balances stored as BigInt in Toman (IRT). Never use Number for money to avoid floating-point precision errors.

nodes.label: Fail-Fast Config Validation
nodes.rationale: Config validation runs at startup before any bot logic. Process exits immediately on invalid env vars, preventing silent misconfiguration.
